loop_2000C.name: Patient Hierarchical Level
loop_2000C.conditional: Required when the patient is a dependent of the subscriber identified in Loop ID-2000B and cannot be uniquely identified to the payer using the subscriber's identifier in the Subscriber Level. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

hl01.name: hierarchical_id_number
hl01.description: Hierarchical ID Number (X12 AN 1/12). 837P content: numeric characters only. Sequential continuing from parent within ST-SE.

hl04.name: hierarchical_child_code
hl04.description: 0=No Subordinate HL Segment in This Hierarchical Structure

pat01.name: individual_relationship_code
pat01.description: 01=Spouse, 19=Child, 20=Employee, 21=Unknown, 39=Organ Donor, 40=Cadaver Donor, 53=Life Partner, G8=Other Relationship. Do not use 18 (Self).

pat05.name: date_time_period_format_qualifier
pat05.conditional: Required when patient is known to be deceased and the date of death is available to the provider billing system. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
pat05.description: D8=Date Expressed in Format CCYYMMDD; paired with PAT06 via syntax_rules P0506

pat06.name: patient_death_date
pat06.conditional: Required when patient is known to be deceased and the date of death is available to the provider billing system. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
pat06.description: Patient death date; paired with PAT05 via syntax_rules P0506

pat07.name: unit_or_basis_for_measurement_code
pat07.conditional: Required when claims involve Medicare Durable Medical Equipment Regional Carriers Certificate of Medical Necessity (DMERC CMN) 02.03, 10.02, or DME MAC 10.03. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
pat07.description: 01=Actual Pounds; paired with PAT08 via syntax_rules P0708

pat08.name: patient_weight
pat08.conditional: Required when claims involve Medicare Durable Medical Equipment Regional Carriers Certificate of Medical Necessity (DMERC CMN) 02.03, 10.02, or DME MAC 10.03. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
pat08.description: Patient weight in pounds; paired with PAT07 via syntax_rules P0708

pat09.name: pregnancy_indicator
pat09.conditional: Required when mandated by law. The determination of pregnancy shall be completed in compliance with applicable law. Y indicates the patient is pregnant. If PAT09 is not used, the patient is not pregnant or the indicator is not mandated by law. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

validation_rules.rule: HL01 is X12 AN 1/12; 837P content must be numeric characters only; sequential within ST-SE
HL02 required and must reference parent 2000B HL01; HL03=23; HL04=0
PAT required; PAT01 required codes 01|19|20|21|39|40|53|G8 only (not 18); PAT02-PAT04 not used; P0506/P0708
2000C required when parent 2000B HL04=1; do not send when patient is the subscriber

nm104.name: patient_first_name
nm104.conditional: Required when the person has a first name. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

nm105.name: patient_middle_name
nm105.conditional: Required when the middle name or initial of the person is needed to identify the individual. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

nm107.name: patient_name_suffix
nm107.conditional: Required when the name suffix is needed to identify the individual. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
nm107.description: Patient name suffix (examples: I, II, III, IV, Jr, Sr)

n302.name: patient_address_line_2
n302.conditional: Required when there is a second address line. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n402.name: patient_state_or_province_code
n402.conditional: Required when the address is in the United States of America, including its territories, or Canada. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n403.name: patient_postal_zone_or_zip_code
n403.conditional: Required when the address is in the US/territories or Canada, or when a postal code exists for the country in N404. For US addresses, the full nine-digit ZIP code must be provided. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n404.name: country_code
n404.conditional: Required when the address is outside the United States of America. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

n407.name: country_subdivision_code
n407.conditional: Required when the address is not in the US/territories or Canada, and the country in N404 has administrative subdivisions. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

dmg01.name: date_time_period_format_qualifier
dmg01.description: D8=Date Expressed in Format CCYYMMDD; paired with DMG02 via syntax_rules P0102

dmg02.name: patient_birth_date
dmg02.description: Patient birth date; paired with DMG01 via syntax_rules P0102

REF_Y4.name: Property and Casualty Claim Number
REF_Y4.conditional: Required when the services included in this claim are to be considered as part of a property and casualty claim. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

ref02.name: property_casualty_claim_number
ref02.description: Property and casualty claim number from the P&C payer

PER.name: Property and Casualty Patient Contact Information
PER.conditional: Required for Property and Casualty claims when this information is different than the information provided in the Subscriber Contact Information PER segment in Loop ID-2010BA and this information is deemed necessary by the submitter. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.

per02.name: patient_contact_name
per02.conditional: Required when the Patient contact is a person other than the person identified in the Patient Name NM1 (Loop ID-2010CA). If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
per02.description: Contact name when different from NM1

per03.name: communication_number_qualifier_1
per03.description: TE=Telephone; paired with PER04 via syntax_rules P0304

per04.name: communication_number_1
per04.description: Telephone number (NANP: AAABBBCCCC, no leading 1); paired with PER03 via syntax_rules P0304

per05.name: communication_number_qualifier_2
per05.conditional: Required when this information is deemed necessary by the submitter. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
per05.description: EX=Telephone Extension; paired with PER06 via syntax_rules P0506

per06.name: communication_number_2
per06.conditional: Required when this information is deemed necessary by the submitter. If not required by this implementation guide, do not send.
per06.description: Telephone extension (numeric only); paired with PER05 via syntax_rules P0506

validation_rules.rule: NM101=QC, NM102=1, NM103 required; NM104/NM105/NM107 situational; NM106 and NM108-NM112 not used; P0809/C1110/C1203
N3 required; N302 situational second line
N4 required; E0207/C0605/C0704; N405-N406 not used; US ZIP nine digits per X222

REF_Y4 situational P&C max 1; REF01=Y4; R0203; REF03-REF04 not used
